mostWorthwhile.text: Turning a remembered painting into an imagined beast was the strongest moment: familiar parts became something absent from the world I had made.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pigment was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision on its own.

surprise.text: The imagined beast revealed a further goal to paint a sky, extending the idea that pictures can depart from observation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the offered combination of memory and echo led to song faster than I expected; it is a compressed mythic gesture rather than an explanation of music's origins.

continue.text: Yes. The makers' ability to create things outside the original world is an appealing hook, although the final song sequence offered only one gameplay action at each step.
